metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2026 · Notes from the Last Row
metas.description: A Korean lit professor and one-time novelist stopped writing after harsh criticism in his youth. Now teaching at a top university, he's frustrated with students' poor writing while living with his own failure.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2026 · If Wishes Could Kill
metas.description: Follows five friends in high school who receive a death warning from a mysterious wish-granting app. As they struggle to escape their fates, they uncover chilling truths that connect the app to the sudden death of a classmate.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2025 · Tempest
metas.description: Munju, an ex-ambassador, and Sanho, a secret agent, investigate an attack that could destabilize the Korean peninsula, unraveling a dangerous conspiracy that jeopardizes regional peace and security.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2025 · Karma
metas.description: Bound by their harrowing destinies, a physician plagued by nightmares, a man shaken after his world was unexpectedly disrupted and a debtor drowning in private loans become caught in inescapable circumstances.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2025 · Undercover High School
metas.description: Ace NIS agent Jung Hae-seong is demoted after a mission failure. He goes undercover at a high school to locate King Gojong's missing gold, meeting his teacher Oh Soo-ah, who sees him as her lost first love, stirring old heartbreak.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2025 · As You Stood By
metas.description: Two women are driven to the brink, facing an inescapable reality that forces them to consider murder as their only way out.
